coverage.story: Filter, stable-sort, aggregate, and emit a canonical chart model for each of five frozen user-control queries.
coverage.rendering: separate; the complete canonical chart model is output by the compute target

counterUnits.allocations: one per explicit Array or TypedArray object/view created from output allocation through controlled-compute output materialization; backing storage is part of the same unit; fixture integrity validation, boundary adaptation, and untimed chart-model decoding are excluded
counterUnits.boundaryCrossings: one per host invocation of an exported Wasm function, including pointer lookup, run, result lookup, and every counter read; JavaScript has zero Wasm export crossings

representation.layout: structure-of-arrays: six contiguous 10,000-element u32 column vectors, followed by the five-query trace
representation.numericPolicy: all predicates, sort keys, sums, and canonical outputs use exact unsigned integer arithmetic; sums are u64 split low/high
representation.sort: bottom-up stable mergesort; revenueCents or units primary key, stableRowId ascending tie-break
representation.chartBins: 16 category bins with count, u64 units sum, and u64 revenue-cents sum
